```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
tar_load(
  c(qa_summary_table, qa_outlier_table, qa_metrics_overview, results),
  store = file.path("..", "_targets")
)
```

## Invariants Snapshot

```{r}
qc_overview <- qa_metrics_overview %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-scenario, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  tidyr::separate(metric, into = c("stat", "metric"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value)
qc_overview
```

## Lag vs Coverage

```{r}
ggplot(qa_summary_table, aes(x = arrival_coverage, y = lag_arrival_mean, color = scenario)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    x = "Arrival coverage",
    y = "Mean lag (T_X - T_P)",
    title = "Lag vs coverage by scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Presence-only Sanity

```{r}
ggplot(qa_summary_table, aes(x = arrival_coverage, y = po_abund_cor, color = scenario)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    x = "Arrival coverage",
    y = "PO vs abundance correlation",
    title = "Presence-only vs abundance correlation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Response-only Edge Metrics

```{r}
qa_summary_table %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(resp_orient_R, resp_edge_dir_R, resp_speed_r2),
    names_to = "metric", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = scenario, y = value, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Response-only edge/orientation metrics by scenario", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Outlier Runs

```{r}
qa_outlier_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(reason = ifelse(reason == "", "(none recorded)", reason))
```

## Diagnostic Rasters

```{r}
diag_dir <- file.path("outputs", "qa")
diag_imgs <- if (dir.exists(diag_dir)) {
  list.files(diag_dir, pattern = "rasters_.*\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
} else {
  character(0)
}
if (length(diag_imgs)) {
  for (img in diag_imgs) {
    cat("![](", img, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("Diagnostics not yet generated. Run the QA targets to populate `outputs/qa/`.\n")
}
```
